methods.name: BRC multiplier basin / squarefree phase calculus
capabilities: exact integer-only multiplier-induced BRC point cost state
exact source-basin to target-support multiplicity histogram
full-range square multiplier support law H=min(s,2k+1)
balanced dense square-refinement multiplicities q or q+1
stable non-square Beatty support with exact Pell endpoint correction
exact squarefree-core plus finite square-refinement phase composition
explicit Boolean-support versus remainder/multiplicity observer-loss witness
methods.core_law: For m=s^2, a source square-root basin of size N=2k+1 occupies exactly min(s,N) target roots; when s<=N the support is consecutive and multiplicities are the balanced q/q+1 partition. For fixed non-square m in the eventual no-skip regime, H_m(k)=Delta_m(k)+1-1[D_m(k+1)<m], where Delta is a two-valued Beatty increment and the exceptional D<m set is generalized-Pell and zero-density. For m=a^2 d, retaining the d-stage root/remainder (y,rho) gives exact final root ay+u and remainder a^2 rho-2ayu-u^2 with 0<=u<a.
methods.hard_boundary: Finite/exact integer BRC calculus only. The Pell count uses classical Pell-unit theory; no factorization speedup, asymptotic complexity improvement, Foundation promotion, signed cancellation semantics, or recovery of erased remainder/provenance is claimed. The non-square closed support formula requires the declared sufficient no-skip regime m<=4k^2; outside it use multiplier_basin_profile rather than extrapolating the formula.

methods.name: BRC consecutive-multiplier root/remainder transition
capabilities: exact fixed-N multiplier root/remainder sequence through m=100 with only one initial N-dependent root materialization
checked-in 99-entry dyadic gamma predictor table for N up to 4096 bits
exact precision specialization by right shift from one high-precision table
cached exact predictor fallback above the static cap
proved at-most-two local BRC odd-width correction steps per transition
exact ceiling completion gap directly from retained root/remainder
composition with classical square-residue prefilter without semantic conflation
methods.core_law: With gamma_m=sqrt((m+1)/m)-1, choose B so J_m<2^(B-1), C_m=floor(2^B gamma_m), d0=floor(C_m J_m/2^B). Then J_(m+1)-(J_m+d0) is in {0,1,2}. The provisional remainder is R_m+N-d0(2J_m+d0); subtracting successive odd basin widths at most twice yields exactly R_(m+1).
methods.hard_boundary: Finite exact integer multiplier scan only; checked-in static performance fast path N<=4096 bits and m<=100. Larger-N predictor generation is cached but no one-off speed claim is made. Performance evidence is environment-specific constant-factor timing. No asymptotic factorization speedup, no novelty claim for multiplier-Fermat/Lehman square-gap factoring, no recovery after erasing R_m, and no Foundation promotion.

methods.name: Exact positive-rational branch-weight histogram and leading-pair calculus
capabilities: exact finite histogram recoalescence and serial convolution
count total-mass dominant-mass and integer-moment readouts
exact prime-valuation histogram terms
dominant weight plus tie multiplicity quotient
exact finite dominant-degeneracy error bound
Newton root-polynomial recovery from finite power sums
methods.core_law: N[Q_{>0}^x] is the exact common positive branch carrier; C,W,M and all integer moments are typed projections, and Lead(H)=(M,d) is an exact quotient.
methods.hard_boundary: Equal-weight branch labels/provenance are not retained. Finite exact representation is not a runtime-complexity theorem. Signed/amplitude and arbitrary irrational/complex weights are outside scope.

methods.name: Exact BRC translated-real-root handoff and Newton resonance pushforward
capabilities: verify one rational-polynomial real root from an exact rational isolating interval including negative translated roots
carry coefficients in a single selected-real-root evaluation algebra with exact zero equality sign and contact tests
handoff a rational Newton jet at a selected irrational translated root and continue through later rational translated roots
verify the semantic zero part of a supplied root-absorption certificate
return the exact affine Newton residual-scale pushforward with source atoms and resonance fibers
verify the prime-valuation resonance relation and expose the scale-one edge fiber
typed_inputs: exact rational isolating interval for one selected real translated root
optional explicit candidate beta=[h]_alpha for absorption verification
typed_outputs: Newton pushforward fibers and source atoms
methods.hard_boundary: No general multi-generator algebraic field, automatic root-expression search, replacement of WBRC-T41 critical-root semantics, complete Puiseux solver, signed branch interference, source-provenance recovery, or infinite-state extension is promoted.
